about: docs/structure.md 12.0q. `valid`: a view that must check. `refusals`: a view (of component C, with `state n`, `state shown` and `on Go`) and the rule tag that refuses it. Checked by crates/cancho-ui/tests/icon.rs.

valid.name: a decorative icon beside words
valid.view: Row { Icon { name: "map-pin" decorative: true } Text { "Madrid" } }

valid.name: each size
valid.view: Icon { label: "a" name: "plus" size: "small" } Icon { label: "b" name: "plus" size: "medium" } Icon { label: "c" name: "plus" size: "large" }

valid.name: an icon inside a labelled button needs no label of its own
valid.view: Button { label: "Mute" on: Go Icon { name: "bell-off" } Text { "Mute" } }

valid.name: an icon in a branch of an If inside a labelled button
valid.view: Button { label: "Toggle" on: Go If { when: shown Icon { name: "bell" } } If { when: !shown Icon { name: "bell-off" } } }

valid.name: a button with an icon before its words
an icon in a rich line and a chip
valid.view: Rich { "a " Icon { label: "Info" name: "info" } " b" } Rich { Chip { tone: "good" Icon { label: "Done" name: "circle-check" } } }

refusals.name: decorative that is not a bool
no label outside a labelled button
no label in a button that has none
a key the icon does not take
icon: on a button with children
refusals.view: Button { label: "a" icon: "bell" on: Go Text { "x" } }

refusals.name: icon: on a button with no label
